answer: Because the timing is published against the dawn challenge, the raven audit can replay the marble history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 136 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2452 identities would post 4781 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
